card.name: Word starts like Sign and bag
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that continues in the next piece, mainly "sign" (as in signaled, significant), "bag", and the start of acronyms like SG(PT) or EG(FR).

modes.label: Acronym starts
modes.description: The first letters of gene or lab acronyms that continue in the next piece.

card.writes: It favors continuations that end in -g sounds such as -ging, -gie, -ged, and -gy, which suits a word still being spelled out.
card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of a word, like Sign- or bag, when more letters are expected to follow.
